d: Lok aastha ke char divsiy mahaparv chhath ko lekar jharkhand ke vibhinn jilon men bhaktimay mahaul bana huaa hai. mahaparv ke dusre din vrati shraddha aur aastha ke sath kharna anushthan men jute hain. kharna ka prasad grahan karne ke bad vrati 36 ghante ka nirjala upvas shuru karenge. kal chhath mahaparv ke tisre din astachalgami bhagvan bhaskar ko pahla arghy arpit kiya jaega. vahin, bal divas ke avsar par rashtrapti draupdi murmu ne bachchon, abhibhavkon aur shikshakon se mulakat ki. is mauke par desh ke pratham pradhanmantri pandit javaharlal nehru ki jayanti par ranchi sthit pradesh…
